civilization.region: East Asia / Southwest China — Sichuan Basin, Chengdu Plain; western Guanghan (~40 km NE of Chengdu)
civilization.time_span: Site occupation c. 2700–1000 BC (Li et al. 2022); Pit 4 radiocarbon 1260–924 cal BC; pit absolute chronology long debated

summary.zh: 四川广汉三星堆青铜时代遗址；1986 一、二号坑与 2020 起新坑；与中原商王国是否同一政体属开放研究。
summary.en: Sanxingdui Bronze Age site in Guanghan, Sichuan; 1986 Pits 1–2 and post-2020 pits; relationship to Shang kingdom remains open research.

sites.kind_note: Large center ~12 km²; settlement/walls and sacrificial area
sites.region: Guanghan, Sichuan, China (~40 km NE of Chengdu)

summary.zh: 约 12 km² 大型中心；含城墙/聚落与祭祀区等遗存类型。
summary.en: Large center (~12 km²) with settlement/walls and sacrificial-area remains.

summary.zh: 正式报告四川省文物考古研究所 1999；一号坑约 4.6×3.5×1.6 m；两坑青铜金玉象牙等九百余件。
summary.en: Primary monograph Sichuan 1999; Pit 1 ~4.6×3.5×1.6 m; >900 bronze/gold/jade/ivory artefacts from the two pits.

summary.zh: Wu et al. 2021：六样 AMS 1260–924 cal BC；平面近方形边长约 2.9 m，最深约 1.6 m。
summary.en: Wu et al. 2021: six AMS dates 1260–924 cal BC; roughly square ~2.9 m side, deepest ~1.6 m.

sites.kind_note: Later Chengdu Plain center juxtaposed with Sanxingdui

summary.zh: Flad 将金沙与三星堆并置讨论贵重物品与城市技术；并置≠已证明简单迁都。
summary.en: Flad juxtaposes Jinsha with Sanxingdui on valuables and urbanism; juxtaposition ≠ proven simple capital relocation.

summary.zh: Li et al. 2022 给出的遗址占用总跨度。
summary.en: Site occupation span as stated by Li et al. 2022.

names.zh: 三星堆考古文化分期（Sun Hua）

time.label: II–IV phases via stratigraphy and pottery (absolute endpoints not invented)

summary.zh: 以地层与陶器界定分期；与坑埋藏年代相关但不同。
summary.en: Phases defined via stratigraphy and pottery; related to but distinct from pit burial dates.

time.label: first half of Anyang period (~13th–12th c. BCE)
time.scheme_note: Bagley 1988 summarizing excavators — chronological label, not polity identity

summary.zh: 发掘者地层关系将两坑置于安阳期前半；「商时期」是年代标签。
summary.en: Excavators placed the pits in first half of Anyang period; “Shang period” is chronological, not polity identity.

time.label: 1260–924 cal BC
time.scheme_note: Wu et al. 2021; Li et al. 2022

summary.zh: 四号坑六个碳十四年代 1260–924 cal BC。
summary.en: Six radiocarbon dates from Pit 4: 1260–924 cal BC.

time.label: Pits 1–4,7–8 ~Yinxu IV 1200–1000 BC; Pits 5–6 maybe early Western Zhou 1046–950 BC
time.scheme_note: Li et al. 2022 citing Ran et al. 2022 — working scheme; absolute chronology long debated

summary.zh: 作者工作方案；文中亦承认祭祀坑绝对年代长期有争议。
summary.en: Authors’ working scheme; they note pit absolute chronology has long been debated.

names.zh: 青铜大型雕像、人像头、面具（组合级）

summary.zh: 二号坑等出土立人、面具是最显著视觉标志；Xu 2001 与 Bagley 英语类型学入口。
summary.en: Large figures, heads, and masks are the hallmark visual corpus; Xu 2001 and Bagley orient typology.

names.zh: 一号坑金杖包皮等金器（组合级）
names.en: Pit 1 gold staff sheathing and related gold (assemblage-level)

summary.zh: Bagley 1988：金皮包木杖约 142 cm，饰人面、鱼、鸟等。
summary.en: Bagley 1988: ~142 cm sheet-gold tube over wood, with faces, fish, birds.

names.zh: 象牙与海贝坑藏（组合级）

summary.zh: 坑藏常见门类；提示区域/远程物资流通可能性，机制不定单一模型。
summary.en: Common pit classes; suggest regional/long-distance material flows without fixing one mechanism.

statement.zh: 三星堆位于广汉西部、成都东北约 40 km，面积约 12 km²，年代约公元前 2700–1000 年；1986 年发现一、二号祭祀坑。
statement.en: Sanxingdui lies in western Guanghan ~40 km NE of Chengdu, covers ~12 km², dates c. 2700–1000 BC; Sacrificial Pits 1–2 discovered in 1986.

statement.zh: 与晚商安阳甲骨文传统不同，三星堆目前没有可与甲骨文比肩的、已系统释读的本遗址文字档案。
statement.en: Unlike Late Shang Anyang oracle bones, Sanxingdui currently lacks a systematically readable local writing archive comparable to jiaguwen.

statement.zh: 四号坑六个碳十四年代为公元前 1260–924 校准年。
statement.en: Six radiocarbon dates from Pit 4 give 1260–924 cal BC.

statement.zh: 与中原商文化/商王国是否为同一政体属开放研究；「商时期」坑年代标签不等于政体等同。
statement.en: Whether Sanxingdui was the same polity as the Shang kingdom remains open research; “Shang period” chronological labels are not polity identity.

claims.disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

statement.zh: 祭祀坑绝对年代长期有争议；新坑工作方案（殷墟四期/西周早期）是作者陈述，不是定论年表。
statement.en: Sacrificial-pit absolute chronology has long been debated; the new-pits working scheme (Yinxu IV / early Western Zhou) is author framing, not a settled calendar.

claims.disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

statement.zh: 教科文预备名单「古蜀国考古遗址」为申报标题用语；预备名单≠已列入世界遗产，亦不等于政体定论。
statement.en: UNESCO Tentative List “Ancient Shu State” is nomination wording; tentative ≠ inscribed, and is not a polity verdict.

claims.disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / contested scholarly reading, not an established archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

title.zh: 教科文古蜀国预备名单条目
title.en: UNESCO Ancient Shu State Tentative List entry

rights.notes: Tentative list only; nomination title ≠ polity verdict.
